mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 74-degree temperatures under overcast skies near City Hall, with an air quality index of 56 due to current moderate conditions.

City officials announced that phase two of the Highway M construction project begins the week of September 7, bringing temporary traffic shifts. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures between Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting in mid-September for bridge replacements.
There is a lot to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddys Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company all through today.

The Verona Police Department reported that on August 30, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and student from 2019, leading to an arrest on September 4.
Culvers is serving up the Mint Cookie flavor of the day and is currently open until their 10:30 PM closing time, so feel free to stop by and grab a treat.
